title: PATCH /api/users/me/ai-settings — save AI provider and encrypted API key
description: Save the user's AI provider choice (openai or anthropic) and their API key. The key is encrypted before storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates that the API key format looks plausible (basic check)
Encrypts the API key using AES-256 before storage

steps.details: aiSettingsSchema = z.object({ provider: z.enum(['openai','anthropic']), apiKey: z.string().min(10).max(500) }). Encrypt apiKey using encrypt(apiKey) from encryption utility (TASK-73). Update user: ai_provider = provider, ai_api_key = encryptedKey. Return 200.
Save OpenAI key — verify provider and encrypted key stored. GET /me — verify hasAiKey = true, raw key not returned.
